packages/claude-envoy/dist and legion/ regenerated; CHANGELOGs of envoy, contracts, envoy-client, pi-envoy, pi-legion, claude-envoy
three forward merges of main (cf81b3ba, 15181b69, 517e10a4), each after GitHub reported CONFLICTING
trickyParts: #2212 merged mid-run and removed evictInstance; the pre-close settlement now relies on its reloadRoomBehindHead, and its retry settles from the reloaded room (plan decision 18). TestClosingAnIssueWithdrawsADecisionBlockWhoseRoomAnotherProcessLeftBehind covers that path.

ygo emits an update for every transaction, a no-op one included, and applyLive appends it: a WriteIssueAskStates that changed nothing appended an empty update and moved the document's settlement mark, which made every interval repair pass sweep every closed issue's documents. writeDocumentAskStates now checks each write against the tree first and opens no transaction when none changes.

A resolve or answer committing between the close's settlement and its transaction leaves the decision's copies owed a settlement that never runs on a closed issue; both sweeps write those copies from their rows (an answered copy without the answer's bytes, since WriteIssueAskStates is not weighed for size).
deviations: Plan R2's evictInstance path is replaced by #2212's reloadRoomBehindHead (the plan's own fallback in decision 18).

Beyond the plan: the answered/resolved copy race (found by the R4 race test), the repair no-op write (found by the R8 proof), the lease pool size, and resolve's 400 message, each fixed here with a test.

R7 local runs at 39c12172 (from a git archive of the head): api ok (1562 s), store ok, cmd/dispatch ok, -tags multiprocess cmd/dispatch ok (350 s); docs failed only TestAHealthyRoomUnderWritesIsNeverRefused ('too few to say anything' under load), which passes alone (ok 6.6 s) and is not in the diff; pmdoc failed only its timing tests and the differential tests that need the workspace's @legion/proof-editor link absent from the archive (pmdoc is not in the diff). bun test packages/contracts packages/envoy-client: one envoy-config timing test failed under load and passes alone. packages/dispatch: typecheck clean; bun test 2388 pass on the re-run (the first run under load had 2 failures not reproduced). biome check of contracts, dispatch, claude-envoy, envoy-client: no errors. claude-envoy check-dist passes. -race was not run locally (the pod has no C compiler); CI's envoy-go-race lane runs it.
openQuestions: applyLive (docs/mutation.go) appends the update ygo emits for a transaction that changes nothing, for every writer, not only WriteIssueAskStates (fixed here at that caller). Another writer that opens a no-op transaction appends an empty update and marks its document owing a settlement. A general fix (a state-vector check in applyLive) touches the shared write path; named to the architect rather than widened here.
